## Professional Summary

Operational Excellence Leader with 14+ years driving Lean transformation, quality management, and continuous improvement in complex, high-reliability manufacturing (Motorola, Samsung, Huawei, Sony, Alcatel). Certified Auditor for ISO 9001 · 14001 · 45001, with hands-on application of Lean tools — Value Stream Mapping (VSM), line balancing, standard work — to raise throughput and First Pass Yield simultaneously. Acting as a bridge between Quality, Engineering, and Production, facilitating improvement workshops and training frontline teams to embed continuous improvement as a daily practice. Leads root-cause analysis and closed-loop CAPA programs with strict metrological traceability, defines and tracks KPIs across production flow, and builds proprietary AI-assisted tools to accelerate quality decision-making.

## Core Competencies & Skills

- **Lean Manufacturing**: Subject Matter Expert (SME), Kaizen, Value Stream Mapping (VSM), Line Balancing, Standard Work.
- **Quality Systems & Standards**: ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001 (Active Integrated Auditor), ISO 17025 (Metrology & Calibration).
- **Core Tools & Failure Prevention**: APQP, PFMEA, DFMEA, Control Plans, CAPA (Closed-Loop), Root Cause Analysis (RCA), 8D, Ishikawa, 5 Whys.
- **Process & Production Engineering**: Statistical Process Control (SPC), Process Flow Optimization, NPI (New Product Introduction).
- **Digital Innovation & AI**: AI Applied to Manufacturing, Gemini / Claude AI Prompting & Workflows, Web App Development for Quality Tools.
- **Project Management**: UTN FRBA Certified Project Management Expert (PMBOK / PMI methodology).
- **Languages**: Spanish (Native), English (Advanced C1/B2+ Technical & Business), Portuguese (Basic / Relocation to Brazil).

## Key Achievements & Proven Metrics

- **+17% Production Increase**: Delivered on Alcatel 4007 mobile line through Lean assembly-line rebalancing and ergonomic workstation optimization, simultaneously exceeding First Pass Yield targets.
- **+10% Planned Production Exceeded**: Delivered on Alcatel 4015 through tactical process-flow optimization, maintaining zero catastrophic defects.
- **-3 Operator Roles Reallocated**: Optimized labor efficiency on Samsung microwave line through Lean line rebalancing, lowering manufacturing costs without compromising reliability.
- **-2 Days Onboarding Time Cut**: Designed and facilitated a peer-to-peer 1-on-1 cross-shift training program for new product launches, accelerating skill acquisition.
- **Closed-Loop CAPA Success**: Eliminated recurrence of critical defects across multiple high-tech electronic manufacturing lines.
- **5+ Global Brands Compliance**: Ensured quality and process standards for Motorola, Samsung, Huawei, Sony, and Alcatel on the plant floor.
